sources.note: Scholarship page: eligibility and how to apply; no subject restriction, no list of departments
Official PhD chooser: every faculty, department, centre and institute that offers PhD study

subject_rule: The scholarship page sets no field-of-study limit: it is competitive on grades and research potential, applications are reviewed by the department applied to, and the College says it recognises excellence in all its Faculties (Engineering, Medicine, Natural Sciences, Imperial Business School). The research must fit a PhD supervisor in an Imperial academic department, so in practice the field is the subjects Imperial's departments supervise.

notes: Doctorate: 25 departments, centres and doctoral programmes recorded from Imperial's official PhD chooser page (10 Engineering, 7 Medicine, 5 Natural Sciences, 1 Business School, 2 Centre for Languages, Culture and Communication). The scholarship page itself does not name departments; the chooser lists where a PhD can be done at Imperial, and the scholarship page adds that some departments may be unable to support international candidates.

Not recorded as rows: the Faculty of Medicine A-Z research directory link, the five Global Challenge institutes (Data Science Institute, Grantham Institute, Institute for Molecular Science and Engineering, Institute for Security Science and Technology, Institute of Global Health Innovation; the chooser tells applicants to contact them before applying) and the Imperial-TUM Joint Academy of Doctoral Studies. The chooser says the Energy Futures Lab offers no PhD.
any_subject is left unset: no page says "any subject" in so many words.
not_stated: No page lists departments that do or do not take President's PhD Scholars, apart from the sentence that some departments may be unable to support international candidates.
